hypothesis_status.R34_observation: GPU6 is the high outlier in R34. Three of four cycles (R31, R32, R34) show one high-state GPU; R33 had none. Confirms the high-regime is a stochastic per-(GPU x cycle) firmware/DPM phenomenon - NOT deterministic. Rotated GPUs across all 4 cycles: GPU0 (R31), GPU5 (R32), none (R33), GPU6 (R34) - 4 distinct outcomes.
